findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Reconcile parent AC8's 'git-delta cost harness' wording with 3388's byte-level per-binding-delta assertion (test_rich_reemit_state.py) — either rename the parent AC to the delivered mechanism or add the named harness.
evidence: Parent AC: 'The git-delta cost harness remains at or below 0.07 KB per stable version.'

3388 roster AC: '≤0.07 KB/version asserted on the serialized per-binding delta (test_rich_reemit_state.py). NOTE: no "git-delta harness" exists in the repo; the byte-level assertion measures the same quantity.'

3388 ticket comment (AC audit before close): 'the AC names a "git-delta cost harness" verifying ≤0.07 KB/version; no such harness exists anywhere in the repo (searched tests/ and scripts/). It is realized here as a direct byte-level assertion … Flagging rather than silently reinterpreting.'
findings.finding: Parent AC8 ('The git-delta cost harness remains at or below 0.07 KB per stable version') names a 'git-delta cost harness' as the verification artifact, but the covering sibling (3388) delivers the outcome via a different mechanism and annotates the discrepancy rather than resolving it: its AC states 'NOTE: no "git-delta harness" exists in the repo; the byte-level assertion measures the same quantity.' This is a bypass/reinterpretation pattern — the parent AC's named measurement artifact does not exist and the child substitutes a byte-level assertion it asserts is equivalent.
findings.location: child 3388-96e8-e14e-4221 (parent AC: 'The git-delta cost harness remains at or below 0.07 KB per stable version')
scenarios: A completion verifier that literally looks for a 'git-delta cost harness' artifact named in the parent AC finds none and treats AC8 as unmet, even though the equivalent budget is asserted by test_rich_reemit_state.py.
A future reviewer reconciling the parent metric against the child's byte-level assertion has to trust the 'measures the same quantity' claim without a named harness to point at.
findings.suggested_fix: Amend parent AC8 to reference the byte-level serialized per-binding-delta assertion (test_rich_reemit_state.py) that 3388 actually delivers, rather than a non-existent 'git-delta cost harness', so the parent criterion and its child realization name the same measurable artifact.
